children: Lighter plans to apply for a US license in November 2026. The license application is part of its stated plan to integrate into Robinhood's US offering.

The proposed Robinhood integration depends on license approval. It would give the token a route to a large US retail audience through Robinhood's US offering, broadening the pool of users who could access it.
